open_points.subject: A18 symbolic-link handling for SQLite files
open_points.text: Rule 2 says “The database file and its journal are opened by SQLite ... the kernel does not watch them after it,” while the formal invariant says “symlink_inside(data_directory) -> refused”.
open_points.question: Does the symbolic-link refusal invariant apply to a database or journal link introduced after startup, or are SQLite-opened files exempt after the startup check?
options: SQLite database and journal links are exempt after startup
All later links, including database and journal links, must be detected and refused
The invariant applies only to startup checks and files the store opens itself
open_points.default_guess: Treat the specific normative SQLite exception as controlling and narrow the invariant to startup plus files the store opens itself.
